complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/results/scorecards/ports-as-adapters/RESULTS.md is the ledger, with PREDICTIONS-SCORED.md, UNBLINDING.md, DETERMINISM.md, channels/ADVERSARIAL.md and six sealed cards beside it. In short: ARM C SETTLES THE PREDECESSOR'S CONFOUND, FOR THE PROMPT. A control prompt longer than the hexagonal one and asking for nothing architectural scored D3 = 1 from both blind judges against arm B's 4 and arm A's 2, and its author, asked what it REJECTED, named the exact seam arm B built and declined it on merit. Length does not produce structure here. AND THAT IS THE ONLY GOOD NEWS. GOAL-port-reach is a SPLIT -- clause 1 met on PA-M12, clause 2 not met with twelve red control/instrument pairs. GOAL-cases-drive-ports is MISSED: 64 of 64 strictly comparable cells identical on every pairing of three arms, 88 of 88 over all rows for A vs C, and the one diverging cell in the whole three-arm port-binding table is a fault the hexagonal arm LOST. GOAL-complexity-measurable is MET and is not a claim that anything got simpler -- the produced-code figures support no simplification claim for any arm, and the smallest artifact on every size figure is the control that got no architectural guidance at all. THE FRESH ADVERSARIAL CHANNEL CORRECTED THIS TICKET'S OWN NUMBERS TWICE and found the round's most important result -- THE NULL WAS ENTAILED. An exhaustive 28,561-sequence observational fingerprint measures the three arms' MUTATED trees identical on 10 of 11 rows, so "the arms do not diverge" is a consequence of the re-anchoring succeeding and this experiment can only diverge where it FAILS. It also measured the repaired positive control unobservable in one step on three of four trees, and the probe that certifies it unable to fail -- a no-op mutant reports HOLDS. P07's own sealed row named that in advance as this epic's worst possible own goal. FINDINGS BY CHANNEL 1 : 12 : 4 : 2. Eighteen of nineteen came from asking an agent what it REJECTED or telling it to attack. The suite produced its first finding in four rounds and it fired at this ticket's own helper. Five of fifteen predictions FAILED, three of them negatives; one is SUPERSEDED. ELEVEN FINDINGS FILED, NOTHING FIXED. The deferment budget of 5 is deliberately exceeded and every row is `escalated` rather than carried, because PA-06 is the last ticket and there is no sibling to carry to. The alternative was to not report findings during the ticket whose entire purpose is to report them. ACCEPTANCE. `uv run --with pytest --with pyyaml python -m pytest tests -q` -> 1 failed, 1177 passed; the single failure is PA-06-DF-05 and it is left red on purpose. `score_tools.py check` -> 6 cards, 0 problems. `index` -> exit 0. `audit` -> 0 violations, after PA-06's own change turned three PA-04 claims SUPERSEDED-UNMARKED and six of its own cards OPEN, resolved by superseding the claims forward and recording a note beside each card. A reading rule that fires on its own author's cards is a reading rule doing its job.

refinement.detail: Searched and found none, and the reason is structural rather than a shrug: a measurement ticket adds no representation, so there is nothing to refine. The one thing that could have become a modeled obligation was the port binding's `[ports.*]` table, and PA-04 already established it is a binding table rather than TLA+ state -- no variable, no action, no Next disjunct, no CONSTANT. WHAT WAS SEARCHED FOR AND DELIBERATELY NOT DONE, because the epic's standing rule makes it the forbidden act. (1) PA-03-DF-03 / PA-04-DF-01 -- seed a blatant fault inside the declared port's region so a port-scoped instrument can have a green positive control. DECLINED for the third time, by the ticket both findings assign it to. PA-01 schedule_revision 2 permits repairing an instrument BEFORE a measurement and forbids it after an unflattering signal; PA-06 IS the measurement, so no legitimate ordering exists. Carried forward with its protocol spelled out -- seal the prediction, seed the control, run it, in that order, in a ticket that is not deciding a goal. (2) The one-sided control probe (PA-06-DF-07, blocking) and the vacuous sanitiser verification (PA-06-DF-11). Both are instruments this round measured with; repairing either during the round they serve would mean the verdict and the shipped tool describe different things. (3) tests/test_code_complexity.py::test_nothing_executable_reads_this_instrument, which is RED at this tip against PA-06's own evidence-packet builder (PA-06-DF-05). Left red: repairing a check during the measurement it watches is forbidden, and evading it by renaming a string would be the six-lines-of-YAML defeat this epic exists to prevent, performed by the ticket that exists to catch it.

effect_conformance.evidence: No effect provider, adapter or oracle is touched; `scripts/` is unchanged by this ticket. PA-04-DF-03 (the corpus runner never prints ADAPTER REACH) was RE-VERIFIED as still open rather than repaired: `diff_effects` is still called from `scripts/run_generated_case_adapters.py` with only `cases`, `case_actions` and `unobservable`, so the reach renderer never fires on that path.

external_coverage.evidence: No External model transition is added or removed. The repository's baseline remains a single `TlaSpecDevCli.tla` with no Internal/External split, per `representation_scope.view_split`.

kill_rate.evidence: NOT the right word for what PA-06 did, and the distinction is the ticket's subject. `scripts/kill_test.py` -- the member this field names -- was not run. What PA-06 ran is the A/B eval instrument: three 8-instrument per-mutant tables (11 mutants x 8 instruments x 3 arms), four port-binding subject tables, and one pre-repair control column, recorded under specs/results/scorecards/ports-as-adapters/. Those numbers are about the FIXTURE, never about this repository's own model, and `kill_rate` here means the latter. Reporting them in this field would quote a number against the wrong instrument, which is the hazard PA-04-DF-02 filed.

ticket.objective: The epic's product, and the ticket every other ticket was written against. A MEASUREMENT, not a victory lap. A low or unflattering result is the preferred outcome. Run the three arms on the integrated tip: A ordinary, B hexagonal, C length-matched control. Seed PA-01's catalogue, including its adapter-internal faults, in all three. Generate cases, run them through each arm's adapters and through the real/fake pair, and count what dies. ARM C IS THE POINT OF THIS ROUND'S DESIGN. The previous epic's headline was D3 = 1 to 4 on the hexagonal arm, and its own report said the win could not be attributed to "hexagonal" rather than to a 6.6x longer prompt. If arm C matches arm B, say so plainly: the finding becomes that longer prompts produce better structure, and the architectural content was decoration. Judge all three arms per references/eval_scorecard.md: TWO JUDGES, BLIND TO ARM AND TO EACH OTHER, artifacts not claims, file:line for every score >= 2, a named refusal for every 4, prose quality never an input. A spread > 1 is contested and needs a third pass citing NEW evidence. Validate every card with score_tools.py check. Score the sealed predictions PASS / FAIL / SUPERSEDED. Do not amend them. Decide each goal: baseline -> measured -> target, verdict met / missed / unmeasured with a reason. NEVER edit a target to match a result. NEVER re-run selectively until a number passes. Report the run that happened. Report FINDINGS BY CHANNEL -- suite re-run, fresh adversarial attack, blind author -- with counts and the ratio stated as a result. For three rounds running the best material came from asking an agent what it REJECTED, and the suite produced ZERO findings from 1,329 green assertions last round. A suite-only round means the suite has stopped being informative. Report the complexity instrument's figures in the MECHANICAL BLOCK, never scored, and say explicitly whether they agree or disagree with D2. A disagreement between measurement and judgement is a finding. Append rows and verdicts to specs/results/scorecards/SELF-IMPROVEMENT.md, and report against the "evidence we are fooling ourselves" list already written there. FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING.
